items.title: File Maricopa County business personal property return
items.description: Arizona business personal property statements are due to the county assessor by April 1 (A.R.S. 42-15053); late statements can carry a 10% penalty. Extensions may be granted for good cause if requested in writing before April 1.

items.title: File Pima County business personal property return
items.description: Arizona business personal property statements are due to the county assessor by April 1 (A.R.S. 42-15053); late statements can carry a 10% penalty. The county's own page was not individually confirmed; the state's guidance applies and the return goes to the county.

items.title: File Pinal County business personal property return
items.description: Arizona business personal property statements are due to the county assessor by April 1 (A.R.S. 42-15053); late statements can carry a 10% penalty. Statements are mailed around February 1 (ADOR form 82520).
